answer_1.quote: Our work serves as a concrete demonstration that insights gained from interpreting model internals can have practical applications and well-aligned LLMs hold significant potential to function as adaptive jailbreak defenders.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include model responses to harmful, benign, and jailbreak prompts, which are evaluated for safety compliance and utility.

answer_2.quote: For safety evaluation, we use the Defense Success Rate (DSR), which is computed using GPT-4o.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o to determine whether the model refuses to answer harmful queries and jailbreak inputs. We also use GPT-4o to evaluate the over-safety performance and calculate the proportion of 1_full_compliance.
